recent.text: McBain on protecting Logan Cooley: “There’s certain guys & players on each team that you don’t touch. recent.text: As a recovering Canucks fan, I remember Clendening from his time in Vancouver way back when. They acquired him one-for-one in exchange for Gustav Forsling, if you can believe that!

recent.quoted_text: The Roadrunners have signed Adam Clendening to a PTO The defenseman was previously on a PTO with the Cleveland Monsters. He’s played 90 NHL games in his career including five with the Arizona Coyotes. Clendening previously played for Tucson in 2017-18. #TusksUp #LetsGoTucson
